meta.name: wrangler
meta.description: Run or troubleshoot Wrangler CLI commands and configure Worker projects for local development, deployment, and Cloudflare resource management.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Cloudflare 项目，本地测试后直接发布上线。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你维护 Cloudflare 上的服务,希望用对话方式完成部署与排障。
copy.tagline_en: Manage Cloudflare projects, test locally and deploy to cloud.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run Cloudflare services and want deployment and troubleshooting handled through conversation.

howto.what: 装了这个技能后,Claude 处理 Wrangler 任务时会先核对项目里的版本和配置,再查对应的官方文档和本地 schema,然后运行或调试命令、修改配置或部署 Worker,并用项目自身流程做校验。
howto.when: 当你请 Claude 运行或调试 Wrangler 命令、修改 wrangler 配置或部署 Cloudflare Worker 时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看为什么 `wrangler deploy` 一直失败,怎么调?
say.note: Claude 会先查项目的版本和帮助文档,定位原因。

say.text: 帮我给 wrangler.jsonc 加一个 R2 桶绑定,再生成类型。
不把密钥写进命令参数,怎么安全地设置 secret?
say.note: Claude 会指引使用交互输入或受保护文件。

howto.what_en: After this skill is installed, Claude verifies the project's Wrangler version and config, checks matching docs and local schema, then runs or debugs commands, edits config or deploys Workers, using the project's own validation.
howto.when_en: When you ask Claude to run or debug Wrangler commands, change wrangler config, or deploy a Cloudflare Worker.

say_en.text: Why does my `wrangler deploy` keep failing? Help me debug it.
say_en.note: Claude checks the project version and help docs to find the cause.

say_en.text: Add an R2 bucket binding to wrangler.jsonc, then run wrangler types.
say_en.note: Claude edits the config per schema and regenerates types.

say_en.text: How can I set a secret without putting it in command arguments?
say_en.note: Claude points to interactive input or protected files.
